How it plays

Six craft, three minutes, a small arena: the most land when the clock runs out wins. Fly out of your land and your craft pays out a cable behind it; come back in to claim everything the cable encloses. If a rival crosses your cable while you are out, it snaps, a spark runs along it and your craft goes up (back in a moment on a fresh patch).

Flying. The craft flies by itself at full speed and never stops. Point the stick where you want to go; let go and it holds its line. After every start it waits for your first touch. BOOST gives a short burst (it recharges).

Pads. Thirteen pads lie flat on the ground and nothing blocks you: fly straight across them. A pad is yours while your colour covers it. Missile pads arm two missiles: keep a rival in front of you to lock on, then tap MISSILE. Mine pads arm mines: tap MINES to drop three behind you.

Land. There are no walls: land is colour, and anyone can cross it. Destroy a rival, by cutting their cable or with a weapon, and all their land becomes yours.

Sound

Sound starts with your first touch. In Safari on an iPhone the silent switch mutes it (the TC World app plays through it). M mutes it on a keyboard.

Sun

Afternoon

Keyboard

A and D or the left and right arrows to steer (S or down to ease off), Shift to boost, E missile, Q mines; C changes the view; M mutes the sound.

  • World Test 12: the ability buildings are flat pads you fly across; missiles and mines only; baked colour, relief and roughness textures for the turf, the stone lanes and the land; a soundtrack, sound effects and an announcer for kills and land share, all made for this game. From World Test 11: hover craft, no barricades, a kill hands you the land. From World Test 10: it flies by itself and you steer. World Test 9's cartoon look: a 240 m arena, toon light and ink outlines; every craft, pad, plant and cloud is a program written for this game.
  • Rendering: HDR with 4x anti-aliasing, glow, ambient occlusion, depth of field, drifting cloud shadows and a colour grade (High; Medium keeps the glow and the grade; Low is the plain picture).
  • Engine: three.js. Type: Baloo 2 by Ek Type (SIL Open Font License).
